text: Manon mentioned her mum turns seventy on June 3rd. They're doing a family lunch somewhere in Lyon. I should send a card a week or so before.
Kenji is leaving the agency at the end of the month. His last day is probably the 28th, but he hasn't confirmed with HR yet.
Florin's daughter starts nursery sometime next week. He seemed more anxious about it than she is.
Lunch with Gareth. His wife Kasia is expecting their second in early March, and they've just found out it's a girl.
Wiremu is really into vinyl at the moment, mostly old soul and reggae pressings. Good to know for his birthday.
Remind me to ask Adaeze how the client pitch went on Thursday. She'd been preparing for weeks and was pretty nervous.
Picked up the dry cleaning and booked the car in for its MOT on 11/4.

Rosa said her brother Carlos is moving to Madrid over the summer for a new job with a logistics firm. She's going to miss him a lot, especially since he's the one who helps with their dad. Their dad has early dementia and Rosa is already juggling a lot at work. She's thinking about asking for flexible hours from September. Worth checking in with her once Carlos has actually gone.

Call with Xavier. The offsite we'd planned for May 14 is cancelled because of budget cuts, which is a shame because Petra had already booked the venue. He's trying to get something smaller arranged for early June instead, probably a dinner in town. His manager wants numbers by the end of the month, so I need to reply to his email with mine by Friday.
Kiara (Kiki to everyone at work) has her driving test on April 22nd. Third attempt, so she's very stressed. Must text her good luck the night before.

Mustafa's dad had a hip replacement last week. He's home now but needs help with stairs, so Mustafa is working from his parents' place in Leicester until the end of the month. His mum isn't coping brilliantly either; she's got arthritis herself and can't do much lifting. Mustafa sounded exhausted on the call. He said the physio comes twice a week and his dad is being a terrible patient.
Lola loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli. She has a whole shelf of the figures.

Jack and Siobhan are celebrating ten years married on September 9th. They're going to Lisbon for a long weekend and leaving the kids with her parents. Siobhan said Jack has no idea she's booked a fado night and a boat trip. Their eldest, Rosa, has her first ballet exam the week after they get back, and she's already practising in the kitchen every evening.
Need to get something for Tanvi's birthday on the 17th. She mentioned wanting a proper pasta machine, the hand-crank kind.
Rohan is coeliac, so book somewhere with decent gluten-free options for the team dinner.

Zara told me her boss is retiring sometime in the spring, and she's been asked to apply for his role. Interviews are expected in late February. She wasn't sure she wanted it at first, but she's warming up to the idea. Should check in with her after Christmas to see if she's put her application in.
Lior had his PhD viva yesterday and passed with minor corrections! Need to send congratulations, maybe a bottle of something nice.
Gabriel's cat Pickle went missing on Sunday. He's put posters up all over the estate and is checking the shelters every morning.
I'm doing the drinks for Petra's leaving do on Friday, so I need to pick up the wine and the cups after work.
Hamza has a big presentation to the board on 3/9. He's rehearsed it a dozen times but still feels he's going to freeze. I should send him a quick message that morning.
Spent ages talking to Aaliyah about her son Jonah, who has just got into the county youth orchestra. He plays cello and practises every evening.
Aurelio mentioned his mother is in hospital again with her heart. He's flying back to Naples on Tuesday and isn't sure when he'll be back.

Wei and her partner just bought their first flat in Walthamstow after almost two years of looking. They get the keys sometime next week and move in at the end of the month. They're planning a housewarming in early December once the sofa arrives. Wei is into plants and good coffee, so a nice houseplant or a bag of beans from that roastery would make a good housewarming gift.
Note for myself: dentist on October 30th at 9:15, and the boiler service is sometime between the 2nd and the 6th of November.
Tomás has been really quiet in stand-ups lately. Turns out his partner left a few weeks ago and he's struggling. I must take him for a coffee this week.

Kwame plays five-a-side every Wednesday and supports Arsenal, which explains his mood most Monday mornings. His birthday is August 2nd, so an away shirt might go down well, or tickets if any come up. He also mentioned his little brother Hamza is starting secondary school in September and Kwame is the one doing the school runs, since their mum works nights at the hospital.

Angela's son graduates from Leeds in mid-July with a first in engineering. She's already planning the trip up with her husband and has booked the hotel for two nights. He's got a graduate job lined up in Bristol starting in early September, so it's a big summer for them. She asked if I knew any decent restaurants near the university for a celebration dinner afterwards.
Siobhan Murphy from the client side said their contract renewal will probably be discussed at the end of the quarter. Follow up with her in early December.
Kasia is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Her sister Manon is visiting from Paris for the whole of November.
Manon's daughter is in the school play on December 12th. She's playing the innkeeper and has three whole lines.
Gareth's mum passed away over the weekend. The funeral is likely to be sometime next week. I need to send a card and ask if there's anything we can cover at work.
Florin keeps dropping hints about a new road bike. His fortieth is on May 20th, so maybe the team could chip in.
Jack said Kenji's wife just had the baby, a little boy called Ren, born on Monday. Don't forget to organise a card from everyone.
Wiremu's performance review got moved from the 15th to sometime early next month. He's annoyed but relieved to have more time to prepare.
Quick catch-up with Zara. Her partner Lorenzo is running the Berlin marathon on September 27th, his first one. She's going over to watch with his parents.
Adaeze has two kids, Kiara and Gabriel. Kiara is eight and obsessed with horses; Gabriel is five and only cares about dinosaurs.

Xavier's sister is getting married over the summer, somewhere in Provence. He's been asked to give a speech and is dreading it, because he hates public speaking and his French isn't great. The stag-and-hen equivalent is in Marseille sometime in May. He also mentioned his girlfriend Aaliyah might be coming, which would be the first time she meets his whole family. He asked if I'd read a draft of the speech once he's written it.
Rosa started at the new firm on Monday. She says the team is lovely but the commute is brutal. Ask her how the first month went around 11/20.
Lola is allergic to nuts and shellfish. Remember that when ordering for the client lunch.
Mustafa and Hamza are both going to the Coldplay gig at Wembley on July 4th. They've had tickets for almost a year.
Rohan's wife Tanvi is having surgery on her knee on the 8th. He'll be taking the week off to look after her and the kids.

Long call with Lior about his brother Jonah, who was made redundant at the start of the month. Jonah has an interview with a fintech company on Friday and another one sometime next week. Lior says he's putting a brave face on it, but their mum is worried sick because Jonah has a mortgage and a baby on the way, due late January. I should message Jonah directly on Friday evening to see how the first interview went.
Wei mentioned that her dog Biscuit turns one on March 3rd and she's planning a little party in the park. Honestly not sure if she was joking.
Kwame's wedding was supposed to be in June, but it's been called off. He didn't want to talk about it much, so I left it.
Petra loves gardening and has started growing chillies on her balcony. She's also into true crime podcasts.
Batch-cook on Sunday, gym Monday and Thursday, and finally sort out the spare room before the end of the month.
Angela told me her husband Gabriel had a scan on Tuesday and they're waiting on the results, probably by the end of next week. She seemed fine on the surface but is clearly worried.
Aaliyah's niece is coming to stay for a few weeks over the summer, while her sister finishes chemo.
Hamza got the promotion! Starts as team lead on July 1st. Remind me to grab him a card and maybe book lunch somewhere decent that week.
Carlos Andersson, the new account manager, mentioned he's training for a triathlon in early September. He also has twin boys, Aurelio and Tomás, who are three.
Tanvi said her mum's birthday is on 6/14, and she wants something from that tea shop in Covent Garden. Get two tins when I'm next in town.

Kenji is nervous about his Japanese citizenship interview on the 23rd. Apparently it's mostly paperwork, but he's worried about his language section. I'll text him good luck the day before and check how it went afterwards.
Kiara's boyfriend Jack is doing a stand-up set at the Comedy Store on Saturday. I'm going with Lola and Wiremu.
Siobhan, Petra and I are taking Rohan out for his birthday on the 19th. I'm booking the table, Petra is handling the cake.
Gareth's daughter Zara got into Edinburgh to study medicine! She starts in September. He's incredibly proud and a bit teary about her leaving.
Florin and his husband are adopting a rescue greyhound called Sunny next weekend. They've been on the waiting list since March.
Need to email Dr Kasia Shah about the referral before Friday.
Manon's son has his GCSE results on August 20th. She says he's convinced he's failed maths, though his teacher isn't worried at all.
Chat with Lorenzo at the coffee machine. He's off to Japan for three weeks in late April for his honeymoon. Ask him for photos when he's back.
Xavier is into bouldering, craft beer and anything by Christopher Nolan. Wants the new Nolan film on Blu-ray for Christmas.
